from itertools import permutations

def find_permutation(S):
    # Generate all unique permutations of the string
    perm = permutations(S)
    # Sort the permutations lexicographically
    sorted_perm = sorted(perm)
    # Convert each permutation tuple to a string
    result = [''.join(p) for p in sorted_perm]
    return result
